tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find or browse current catalog products by name, model or SKU; returns a bounded page with an exact total. Get contextual filter IDs from get_catalog_filters and brand IDs from search_brands; do not guess IDs. Read a selected result with get_product; narrow overly broad queries. Public; no OAuth req

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Inspect one product selected by search_products: current price, aggregate warehouse stock and public characteristics. Use its internal product_id, not the SKU; get_products_batch reads several known IDs. Stock does not promise same-day pickup; unknown values remain null. Public; no OAuth required. R

tools.name: get_products_batch
tools.description: Read 1 to 10 unique products by internal ID. Returns items in requested order and missing_ids for unpublished or absent products. Each ID consumes one normal catalog quota unit; no URLs, buyer actions or writes are accepted. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Find or browse brands through storefront brand search, including typo suggestions. Returns paginated public brand links and IDs for search_products.brand_id; this finds brands, not products. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only.

tools.name: get_catalog_filters
tools.description: Read available filter groups, values and ranges before a filtered search_products call. Supply a real section_id or brand_id and keep the same catalog context; use returned characteristic IDs, never invented IDs. This returns filter metadata, not product results. Public; no OAuth required. Read-only

tools.name: get_product_reviews
tools.description: Read customer feedback for a product selected with get_product, not its specifications. Returns only moderated, published review text, ratings and rating_summary; no pending reviews or review submission. Use page or cursor, never both; an empty list means no published reviews, not a zero-star rating

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Inspect the consenting buyer's existing basket before changing its lines; rechecks current prices and stock and returns item_id for update_cart_item or remove_cart_item. Use get_checkout for delivery, payment and contact choices, not this tool. OAuth scopes: cart:read. Read-only.

tools.name: add_cart_item
tools.description: Add quantity units of a product selected with get_product to the consenting buyer's basket. Quantity is an increment; use update_cart_item with an item_id from get_cart for an absolute final quantity. Do not retry an uncertain add blindly; read get_cart to reconcile. Does not create an order. OAuth

tools.name: update_cart_item
tools.description: Set the absolute quantity of a basket line using its item_id from get_cart, not product_id. Zero removes the line; use add_cart_item to increment instead. Returns the refreshed basket; no order or payment. OAuth scopes: cart:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: remove_cart_item
tools.description: Delete the complete basket line identified by this buyer's get_cart item_id; not product_id or a favorites entry. Use update_cart_item to retain the line with a smaller quantity. Returns the refreshed basket; no order or payment. OAuth scopes: cart:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: get_favorites
tools.description: List the consenting buyer's saved product IDs; inspect their current details with get_product or get_products_batch. Use add_favorite or remove_favorite to change this list; favorites are not basket contents. OAuth scopes: favorites:read. Read-only.

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.description: Save a current public product in this buyer's favorites, without adding it to the basket. Use get_favorites to inspect the saved list or remove_favorite to undo; use add_cart_item for a purchase basket. OAuth scopes: favorites:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove a saved product from this buyer's favorites using its product_id from get_favorites, not a basket item_id. Does not remove it from the basket; use remove_cart_item for that. Returns the updated favorites list. OAuth scopes: favorites:write. Changes buyer or order state.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Inspect delivery, payment and contact choices, validation and store options before update_checkout or prepare_order. Use get_cart for basket lines alone. Unquoted delivery and final totals stay null; no order is created and no payment is made. OAuth scopes: checkout:read. Read-only.

labels.name: delete_webhook
labels.description: Revoke an owned order event subscription and cancel queued deliveries. An already in-flight HTTPS request cannot be recalled. OAuth scopes: webhooks:write. Changes buyer or order state.

labels.name: list_webhook_deliveries
labels.description: Read the latest 100 delivery attempts for an owned subscription, without event payloads or secrets. OAuth scopes: webhooks:read. Read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_reviews · Private data: update_checkout, submit_order, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Public sink: update_checkout, prepare_order, submit_order, create_webhook, delete_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: remove_cart_item, remove_favorite, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_reviews · Private data: update_checkout, submit_order, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Public sink: update_checkout, prepare_order, submit_order, create_webhook, delete_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: remove_cart_item, remove_favorite, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_products_batch, get_product_reviews, update_checkout · Private data: get_cart, get_checkout, update_checkout, submit_order, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Public sink: prepare_order, submit_order, create_webhook, delete_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: remove_cart_item, remove_favorite, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_products_batch, get_product_reviews, update_checkout · Private data: get_cart, get_checkout, update_checkout, submit_order, list_webhooks, create_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Public sink: prepare_order, submit_order, create_webhook, delete_webhook, list_webhook_deliveries · Destructive: remove_cart_item, remove_favorite, delete_webhook

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
